observation_nodes.label: Professor Tealeaf
observation_nodes.description: A trusted contact at the Wizard’s College in Mirathorn; the party sends a message to Tealeaf and later learns Tealeaf is working with Grobnok to stabilize the city.

observation_nodes.label: Grobnok
observation_nodes.description: City contact communicating with the party by rockie-talkie; reports worsening corruption outbreak, compromised contacts, council actions, and ongoing city instability.

observation_nodes.label: Private Hester
observation_nodes.description: A young Elderwild Reach rider carrying sealed reports for Mirathorn; warns of mysterious music and people walking into the swamp, and advises speaking with Commander Vale.

observation_nodes.label: Commander Vale
observation_nodes.description: A Reach commander identified by Private Hester as someone Lysandra should consult before entering the swamp.

observation_nodes.label: Frank
observation_nodes.description: An individual in Mirathorn from whom Grobnok took the rockie-talkie after Frank appeared compromised.

observation_nodes.label: Sara
observation_nodes.description: A Mirathorn contact Grobnok has not seen recently amid the city’s crisis.

observation_nodes.label: Dustwalker
observation_nodes.description: A festival performer whose song matches the rhythm and tune the party later finds themselves humming near Mireward.

observation_nodes.label: the Shepherd
observation_nodes.description: A cult figure being openly recruited for by the 'meat heads' during the Mirathorn unrest.

observation_nodes.label: Lysandro
observation_nodes.description: Lysandra’s father, encountered as a guard on the wall when the party arrives at Mireward.

observation_nodes.label: the Reach
observation_nodes.description: Regional area the group focuses on while traveling north toward Mireward.

observation_nodes.label: Golden Fields
observation_nodes.description: A vast area to the north associated with the Reach.

observation_nodes.label: Mireward
observation_nodes.description: Named destination north of the party's current route; marked as 20 miles north at a fork.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn
observation_nodes.description: City behind the group and a key communication point; multiple references to returning/contacting it.

observation_nodes.label: Wizard’s College
observation_nodes.description: Institution in the city considered a trusted contact point.

observation_nodes.label: the swamp
observation_nodes.description: Problem area where people reportedly walk into mysterious music; party is instructed to continue there.

observation_nodes.label: fork in the road
observation_nodes.description: Road junction ahead of the party where a sign points toward Mireward.

observation_nodes.label: abandoned restaurant
observation_nodes.description: Small roadside building near the fork; recently abandoned and used as storm shelter.

observation_nodes.label: Elderwild Reach military
observation_nodes.description: Military force identified by its uniform; includes ranks such as Private and Commander, and is involved in reporting threats around the swamp and Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Wizard’s College
observation_nodes.description: Institution in Mirathorn considered by the party as a relatively trustworthy contact point during city instability.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn council
observation_nodes.description: City governing body coordinating response to outbreak and corruption, issuing operational instructions to the party, and directing hiring of mercenaries due to guard losses.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn city guard
observation_nodes.description: Primary city security force described as heavily reduced/decimated by corruption during the outbreak.

observation_nodes.label: Hired mercenaries in Mirathorn
observation_nodes.description: Mercenary forces hired by the council as a contingency after city guard losses; currently in an uneasy truce with another street faction.

observation_nodes.label: "Meat heads"
observation_nodes.description: Named faction in Mirathorn involved in tensions with mercenaries; increasingly vocal and open in recruiting for the Shepherd.

observation_nodes.label: Followers of the Shepherd
observation_nodes.description: Recruitment target of the "meat heads"; associated with growing cult-like activity in and around Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Questionable Company
observation_nodes.description: The adventuring party/group conducting the mission toward Mireward and the swamp source of cult activity.

observation_nodes.label: rockie-talkie
observation_nodes.description: Portable communication device used repeatedly by the party to contact Mirathorn and speak with Grobnok.

observation_nodes.label: silver raven
observation_nodes.description: Message-carrying object sent toward Mirathorn with encoded and spoken/written updates for trusted contacts.

observation_nodes.label: wagon
observation_nodes.description: Primary transport and cargo vehicle used throughout overland travel in this session.

observation_nodes.label: sealed report tube
observation_nodes.description: Sealed tube carried by Private Hester containing reports intended for Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Whisper Bottle
observation_nodes.description: Caelynn's magical focus/tool used to cast Detect Magic on anomalous puddle water.

observation_nodes.label: vial of conjuration-tainted puddle water
observation_nodes.description: Sampled vial of shimmering puddle water; Identify indicates it should not be consumed and suggests planar magical bleed/conjuration involvement.

observation_nodes.label: chalkboard menu sign
observation_nodes.description: Sign outside the abandoned restaurant, hastily changed to read 'headed south, north wrong,' implying recent warning/evacuation behavior.

observation_nodes.label: jar of old meat skewers
observation_nodes.description: Stored food remnant found in the restaurant trapdoor storage area; meat is old and graying.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn communication instability and possible internal compromise
observation_nodes.description: The party repeatedly fails to contact Mirathorn, then learns key contacts may be compromised (Frank), Sara is missing, and future contact is restricted to Grobnok alone, suggesting unreliable channels and possible infiltration.

observation_nodes.label: Shimmering puddles with delayed reflections and conjuration bleed
observation_nodes.description: Roadside puddles show reflections delayed by about a second; Detect Magic identifies conjuration signatures, and later analysis suggests planar bleed being conjured from elsewhere. Potential environmental and ecological threat remains unresolved.

observation_nodes.label: Mysterious music linked to compelled movement toward swamp
observation_nodes.description: Field reports describe people hearing mysterious music and walking into the swamp nonresponsive; later the party unconsciously hums the same song tied to prior Dustwalker performance, indicating possible memetic or magical influence.

observation_nodes.label: Converging storms and extreme localized hail event
observation_nodes.description: Multiple storm systems converge (west and south), producing ominous conditions and a massive hail wall. The scale and behavior appear unusual and may be connected to wider regional disturbances.

observation_nodes.label: Renewed corruption outbreak and broadening infection profile in Mirathorn
observation_nodes.description: Mirathorn suffers another major outbreak after failed containment of corrupted meat; guard strength declines, mercenaries are hired, and a gnome with shimmering eyes is identified despite prior pattern affecting humans, implying mutation/spread dynamics are changing.

observation_nodes.label: Shepherd-aligned faction ('meat heads') becoming overt and organized
observation_nodes.description: The 'meat heads' grow more vocal and openly recruit for the Shepherd amid city instability, signaling an emboldened cult presence and possible escalation timeline.

observation_nodes.label: Abandoned roadside stop warning that 'north wrong'
observation_nodes.description: A recently abandoned restaurant displays a hastily altered message, 'headed south, north wrong,' implying civilian flight and perceived danger specifically in the party’s direction of travel.

observation_nodes.label: Disembodied knocking with no visible source
observation_nodes.description: Karsemine hears clear door-knocking sounds after the storm but cannot locate any source or nearby structure with a door, indicating a possible auditory anomaly or hidden presence.

observation_nodes.label: Operational directive: consult Commander Vale before entering swamp source zone
observation_nodes.description: Private Hester warns the party to speak with Commander Vale before entering the swamp, while city leadership believes the core problem originates there; this establishes an immediate investigative and mission thread.

ignored_items.label: Mood shifts and interpersonal distrust within party
ignored_items.reason: Character dynamics are present but do not add distinct external mystery-state beyond already captured trust/compromise signals.

deferred_items.label: Validation of Lysandra's stated true intentions
deferred_items.reason: Suggestion-produced statement aligns with mission objective but does not conclusively prove reliability under broader compromise concerns.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Corroborate Lysandra’s intent via independent evidence from Commander Vale, prior orders, and observed actions in Mireward/swamp operations.

deferred_items.label: Strange savory mist at dawn
deferred_items.reason: Potentially linked to known corruption motifs but insufficient detail in this session alone to classify as standalone mystery node.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Track recurrence frequency, location, and timing; compare with outbreak zones and song/compulsion events.

observation_beats.title: Route decision and storm-laden departure
observation_beats.summary: The party breaks camp, weighs continuing north toward Mireward versus returning to Mirathorn, and travels under worsening storm conditions with unusual magical sheen on the trail.

observation_beats.title: Failed contact and encoded outreach to trusted allies
observation_beats.summary: After failing to reach Mirathorn by rockie-talkie, the group devises a secure communication plan, sending messages via silver raven to Professor Tealeaf and encoded content for Grobnok.

observation_beats.title: Northward travel reveals social strain and anomalous reflections
observation_beats.summary: Travel continues as converging storms loom; party dialogue highlights distrust and tension around Lysandra, and Karsemine notices puddle reflections lagging behind reality.

observation_beats.title: Courier encounter: swamp compulsion reports and warning
observation_beats.summary: The group aids exhausted rider Private Hester, learns reports of mysterious music drawing people unresponsively into the swamp, and receives advice to consult Commander Vale before entering.

observation_beats.title: Field test of puddle magic
observation_beats.summary: Caelynn detects pervasive magic and identifies puddle magic as conjuration; the party samples and physically tests puddle water but observes no immediate effect.

observation_beats.title: Camp analysis and dire Mirathorn update
observation_beats.summary: At camp, analysis suggests planar magical bleed affecting the environment; Grobnok reports renewed city outbreak, compromised contacts, reduced guard, mercenary reliance, and council orders to proceed to the swamp while restricting future comms to himself.

observation_beats.title: Night watches, recurring signals, and urgent weather shift
observation_beats.summary: During watches, the party notes rhythmic northern sound and strange mist; by dawn a major hailstorm threat is identified, prompting a push for shelter.

observation_beats.title: Shared humming links to prior Dustwalker song
observation_beats.summary: Morale improves and Lysandra confides leadership doubts, then all members realize they are unconsciously humming the same tune, identified as the Dustwalker festival song, as they near the Mireward road fork.

observation_beats.title: Abandoned roadside stop and hailstorm shelter
observation_beats.summary: The party investigates a recently abandoned restaurant marked with warning text ('headed south, north wrong'), then fortifies and shelters there through a severe hail barrage.

observation_beats.title: Post-storm travel and impossible knocking sound
observation_beats.summary: After assessing mostly limited storm damage, Karsemine hears persistent door-knocking despite no visible source or structure matching the sound.

observation_beats.title: Second Grobnok report and internal trust fracture
observation_beats.summary: Grobnok reports worsening city instability, open Shepherd recruitment, and a new non-human shimmering-eyes case; Stafl’s argument and handling of the rockie-talkie reveal growing mistrust toward city-linked members, including Lysandra.

observation_beats.title: Suggestion cast on Lysandra and arrival at Mireward gate
observation_beats.summary: Stafl casts Suggestion to probe Lysandra’s motives; she states intent to keep the team focused on destroying the swamp cult source. The group reaches a guarded wall at night and has an awkward introduction sequence.

observation_beats.title: Reveal of Lysandra’s father
observation_beats.summary: At the gate, the guard recognizes Lysandra as his daughter, introducing him as Lysandro.
